intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The abstract reports a homozygous ANK3 mutation in one consanguineous family with intellectual disability. It does not name MRT37 or state autosomal recessive inheritance; a general causal statement about the disorder goes beyond this single family.

paragraphs.text: Iqbal et al. (2013) reported a consanguineous family in which affected members had moderate intellectual disability, an ADHD-like phenotype, and behavioral problems.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) reported a consanguineous family with MRT37.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports the consanguineous family. 'MRT37' is the draft's own label for the disorder, not a term the paper uses.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 reported by Iqbal et al. (2013) had moderate intellectual disability.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The abstract states moderate intellectual disability in this family.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 reported by Iqbal et al. (2013) had an ADHD-like phenotype.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The abstract states an ADHD-like phenotype in this family.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 reported by Iqbal et al. (2013) had behavioral problems.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The abstract states behavioral problems in this family.

paragraphs.text: The transmission pattern of MRT37 in the family reported by Iqbal et al. (2013) was consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance.

checks.claim: The transmission pattern of MRT37 in the family reported by Iqbal et al. (2013) was consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation
checks.explanation: A homozygous mutation in a consanguineous family implies recessive inheritance, but the abstract does not state the inheritance pattern or give segregation data.

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with MRT37, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene. The authors stated that this was the first familial mutation reported in ANK3. Iqbal et al. (2013) also studied an unrelated patient with borderline intelligence, severe attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism, and sleeping problems in whom all isoforms of ANK3 were disrupted by a balanced translocation. Knockdown in Drosophila produced memory defects, which the authors took as support for the causal role of the ANK3 mutations in both families.

checks.explanation: The authors state this is the first familial ANK3 mutation reported.
